extract_lsp_dataset: extract LSP dataset annotations from joints.mat and save to npz format for testing
create_lsp_test_data: create an npz file with image names, centers, scales, and keypoints from LSP joints data
compute_lsp_bounding_boxes: compute bounding boxes, centers, and scales for LSP dataset keypoints with a 1.2 expansion factor
convert_lsp_mat_to_npz: convert LSP dataset joints.mat annotations into a structured npz file with segmentation paths
load_lsp_joints: load LSP dataset joints from a scipy mat file and extract 14 keypoints per image
